args.body:
Summary of websites shared in #general:

1. www.informations.com (shared by Bob) — The latest job report brought a mix of relief and concern as unemployment edged down to 7.2%.

2. www.restaurant-zurich.com (shared by Eve) — Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the heart of the city, renowned for authentic Swiss cuisine. The menu features traditional dishes such as cheese fondue, hearty rösti, and chocolate fondue for dessert. Warm wooden interiors with Swiss memorabilia create a welcoming, rustic atmosphere, and large windows offer stunning panoramic views of the city skyline. Friendly staff dressed in traditional Swiss attire make each visit feel like a journey to the Swiss Alps.

Hi Dora! I visited your website (www.dora-website.com). It's a nice, clean personal site that introduces you and makes it easy to get in touch. A couple of suggestions to make it even stronger: add a bit more content about your interests, skills, or projects, and include links to your other profiles or a contact form so visitors can follow up. Overall, a friendly and welcoming introduction — keep it up!

Hi Eve! I visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com). I like that it clearly centers on your passion for hiking — that's a great theme and makes the blog feel personal and authentic. To make it even more engaging, consider adding recent trip write-ups with photos, trail details (distance, difficulty, elevation), and maybe a map or gear recommendations for fellow hikers. A short intro about who you are and why you hike would also help new readers connect with you. Looking forward to reading more about your adventures!
